variables.name: ENGLANDSOFTWARE_PORT
variables.description: TCP port the HTTP server listens on. Defaults to 8493 and should match the published container port.

variables.name: ENGLANDSOFTWARE_ADMIN_USERNAME
variables.description: Username for the admin inbox sign in.

variables.name: ENGLANDSOFTWARE_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password for the admin inbox sign in. Set a unique strong value in config/.env.

variables.name: ENGLANDSOFTWARE_SECURE_COOKIES
variables.description: Set to true when the site is served over HTTPS so admin cookies use the Secure attribute.

variables.name: ENGLANDSOFTWARE_TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS
variables.description: Comma-separated CIDR ranges of trusted reverse proxies whose forwarded client IP headers may be used.
